$description: Design tokens of the tonegliseavalenciennes.fr redesign, validated with the home page mockup on 2026-10-25 and harmonised across all pages on 2026-10-27; signal and mint colours added on 2026-10-29. Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group 2025.10. Rules for using them: DESIGN.md.

primary.$description: Brand blue from the logo. Every button (filled, or outlined for secondary actions), links, icons. White text on it: 5.9:1.

primary-hover.$description: Hover state of primary links and buttons. White text on it: 8.4:1.

secondary.$description: Night blue. Headings, hero overlay, footer, date badges, current menu item. On white: 15.6:1.

accent.$description: Sun yellow. A small signature on every page: the bar under every page title (the underline of "nous" on the home page), every play button, the dot before "Vous êtes ici", quote marks, the last timeline dot. Never text, never a button, never on the menu.

signal.$description: Coral. Always means "now" or "new": the "En direct" tag of the Sunday live stream, the "Nouveau" tag on a recently added event. Always a filled tag with night-blue text on it (5.5:1); never text (2.8:1 on white), never a button, never a section background. Rare: once or twice per page at most, and never in the same spot as the yellow accent.

text-muted.$description: Labels, dates, captions. On white 6.2:1, on sand 5.6:1, on sky 5.5:1.

surface-sand.$description: Page background, info cards, department tiles, form panels, the closing block before the footer, image placeholders on white or sky.

surface-sky.$description: Events section, "Nos valeurs" section, "Comment faire un don ?", contact card "Demande de prière", image placeholders on sand.

surface-sun.$description: Bible verse, date tag, contact card "Nous contacter", [à compléter] markers.

surface-mint.$description: Mint. A section background in the white, sky, sand rotation ("Chaque semaine" on the events page) or a panel background ("Réduction d'impôt" on the donation page). Never next to sand, so never the last section of an inner page, since the closing block is sand. Body text 10.0:1, links 5.2:1, muted text 5.5:1.

border.$description: Hairlines inside a section on white: map, cards, accordion rows, table rows. Never between two sections: neighbouring sections differ by background instead.

border-tint.$description: Hairlines inside a section on sky or sand (accordion rows of "Nos valeurs"), where color.border would disappear.

hero.$description: Layer over the blurred hero photo; keeps white text at 6.7:1 or more.

page-title.$description: Title (h1) in the banner of inner pages, computer.

page-title-mobile.$description: Title (h1) in the banner of inner pages, phone.

section-title.$description: Every section title (h2), computer, on every page.

block-title.$description: Title of a block inside a section (h2 or h3): form panels, "Présentation", side panel headings, numbered headings of legal pages. Computer.

card-title.$description: Card titles (h3) and contact card labels, computer.

card-title-mobile.$description: Card titles (h3) and contact card labels, phone.

small-title.$description: Small headings: footer columns, "Partager l'évènement", "Dans la rubrique" label. Computer and phone.

body-mobile.$description: Body text, phone. Never below 16 px for running text.

caption.$description: Dates and labels. The smallest size allowed.

button.$description: Buttons, tags, date badges, menu items.

round.$description: Only icon circles and the play button.

container.$description: Maximum content width of every section, header included.

section-padding.$description: Vertical padding of every section, computer.

section-padding-mobile.$description: Vertical padding of every section, phone.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus outline: secondary colour on light areas, white on dark areas, 3 px offset.

accent-bar-width.$description: Yellow bar under the page title in every banner (64 px on a phone).

accent-bar-width-mobile.$description: Yellow bar under the page title, phone.

accent-bar-height.$description: Thickness of the yellow bar under the page title (4 px on a phone).

accent-bar-height-mobile.$description: Thickness of the yellow bar, phone.
